opera1.name: Hitting the Golden Bough
opera1.desc: Emperor Daizong of Tang betrothed Princess Shengping to Guo Ai. During a grand birthday feast, the Princess's absence sparked a heated argument, leading Guo Ai to strike her in anger. The Emperor, prioritizing family harmony and filial piety, wisely pardoned Guo and counseled the Princess on marital virtues.

opera2.name: Ascending the Throne
opera2.desc: With the aid of Princess Daizhan, Xue Pinggui captured Chang'an and ascended the throne. He honored both Wang Baochuan and Daizhan as empresses, rewarded his loyal allies, and dealt justice to his enemies, ultimately achieving a grand reconciliation of power and family.

list.name: Ding Guoxian
list.desc: Ding Guoxian (1909-1972) was a legendary Jinju performing artist and the founder of the Ding School. She pioneered the tradition of female actresses playing 'Xusheng' roles. Her masterpieces include 'The Empty Fort Strategy' and 'Hitting the Golden Bough'.

list.name: Niu Guiying
list.desc: Niu Guiying (1925-2013) was a renowned Jinju artist and the founder of the Niu School. Specializing in 'Qingyi' roles, she was celebrated for her elegant singing and delicate performances. Her representative works include 'Hitting the Golden Bough' and 'Calculating the Grain'.

list.name: Xie Tao
list.desc: Xie Tao (1967-), a contemporary Jinju performing artist and a national-level inheritor of intangible cultural heritage. She has inherited and further developed the Ding School's artistry. Her famous repertoires include 'Fan Jin Passing the Imperial Exam' and 'Fu Shan Entering Beijing'.

list.name: Song Zhuanzhuan
list.desc: Song Zhuanzhuan (1960-) is a celebrated Jinju artist famous for her unique 'Zhuanzhuan Melody.' Known for her wide vocal range and distinctive singing style, her masterpieces include 'Du Shiniang' and 'Tears of the Jade Cicada'.

list.name: Guo Caiping
list.desc: Guo Caiping (1944-) is a distinguished Jinju artist specializing in 'Xiaosheng' roles. Her performance style is natural and elegant, complemented by her high-pitched and passionate singing. Her representative works include 'The Small Banquet' and 'The Butterfly Cup'.
